title: Retail Price Ripples
affiliations: , University of Guelph, Gordon S. Lang School of Business and Economics and Bar-Ilan University - Department of Economics

detail.title: Retail Price Ripples

declarations.funderStatement: The empirical results in this paper are the researchers’ own analyses calculated (or derived) based in part on data from Nielsen Consumer LLC and marketing databases provided through the NielsenIQ Datasets at the Kilts Center for Marketing Data Center at The University of Chicago Booth School of Business. The conclusions drawn from the NielsenIQ data are those of the researcher(s) and do not reflect the views of NielsenIQ. NielsenIQ is not responsible for, had no role in, and was not involved in analyzing and preparing the results reported herein. The authors are responsible for any remaining errors.

detail.abstract: Much like small ripples in a stream, which get lost in the larger waves, small changes in retail prices often fly under the radar of public perceptions, while large price changes appear as marketing moves associated with demand and competition.  Unnoticed, these could increase consumers’ out-of-pocket expenses.  Indeed, retailers could boost their profits by making numerous small price increases or by obfuscating large price increases with numerous small price decreases, thereby bypassing the consumer’s full attention and consideration, and triggering consumer fairness concerns.  Yet only a handful of papers study small price changes.  Extant results are often based on a single retailer, limited products, short time span, and legacy datasets dating back to the 1980s and 1990s – leaving their current practical relevance questionable.  Researchers have also questioned whether the reported observations of small price changes are artifacts of measurement errors driven by data aggregation.  In a series of analyses of a large dataset (almost 79 billion weekly price observations from 2006 to 2015, covering 527 products, and about 35,000 stores across 161 retailers), we find robust evidence of asymmetric pricing in the small (APIS), where small price increases outnumber small price decreases, but no such asymmetry is present in the large.  We also document the reverse phenomenon (APIS-R), where small price decreases outnumber small price increases.  Our results are robust to several possible measurement issues. Importantly, our findings indicate a greater current relevance and generalizability of such asymmetric pricing practices than the existing literature recognizes.

AI.tldr: 研究发现零售价格存在"小幅不对称定价"现象，即小幅涨价比小幅降价更常见，但大幅价格变动则没有这种不对称性。研究基于大规模数据集（2006-2015年近790亿周度价格观测），证明这种定价策略在当前零售环境中仍然普遍存在。
AI.research_question: 零售市场中是否存在小幅价格变动的不对称性？这种不对称定价在当前零售环境中是否仍然普遍存在？
AI.motivation: 小幅价格变动往往被消费者忽视，零售商可能利用这一点通过频繁小幅涨价或混淆大幅涨价来增加利润，但现有研究存在数据局限（单一零售商、有限产品、时间跨度短、数据陈旧），且可能受测量误差影响，其实践相关性存疑。
AI.theoretical_framework: 消费者注意力理论（消费者对小幅价格变动不敏感）、公平感知理论（零售商策略可能引发消费者公平担忧）、不对称定价理论
AI.method: 基于大规模数据集分析（2006-2015年近790亿周度价格观测，涵盖527种产品、约35,000家商店、161家零售商），采用稳健性检验排除测量误差影响
AI.findings: 发现显著的小幅不对称定价现象：小幅涨价数量超过小幅降价，但大幅价格变动没有这种不对称性；同时发现反向现象（小幅降价超过小幅涨价）；结果对多种测量问题具有稳健性
AI.theory_contributions: 证实小幅不对称定价在当前零售环境中仍然普遍存在，扩展了不对称定价理论的时间跨度和适用范围；提供了反向不对称定价的证据；解决了现有文献中关于测量误差和数据局限性的争议
AI.practical_contributions: 为零售商提供了利用消费者注意力局限的定价策略证据；为消费者保护机构和政策制定者揭示了可能损害消费者利益的定价实践；为市场监督提供了实证依据

title: Labour as Relational Agency: An Autistic Theory of Structural Violence Against Non-Market Work in the Age of AI
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Labour as Relational Agency: An Autistic Theory of Structural Violence Against Non-Market Work in the Age of AI

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest. The research was conducted independently and received no influence from any organization, institution, or commercial entity.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study is based on autoethnographic field research conducted by the author. No human participants were recruited, and no external datasets involving personal data were used. Therefore, formal ethics committee approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. It was carried out independently by the author as part of long-term Artistic Research.

detail.abstract: This paper proposes a new ontology of labour that defines work not as the production of marketable output but as relational agency: embodied, self-determined interaction that generates social and ecological reality through resonance. The core thesis is that capitalist economies do not merely neglect non-market forms of labour-such as artistic practice, care work, activism, and deep autistic focus-but structurally attack them, because relational labour destabilises the value regime on which capitalist legitimacy depends. Drawing on methodologies of Artistic Research and neurodivergent cognition, the paper conceptualises autistic, embodied work as a high-resolution mode of system analysis, in which sensing, thinking and acting remain inseparable. Under this model, lived cognition functions as a measurement device rather than a source of bias. The analysis combines philosophical argument with empirical evidence derived from ten years of autoethnographic field research inside German state institutions and corporate environments. These encounters-which resulted in escalating administrative sanctions, bureaucratic harassment, and legal repression-demonstrate that punishment did not follow refusal to work, but followed precisely when the author's self-determined labour exposed institutional dysfunction. Rather than representing personal misfortune, these events constitute a dataset revealing a general mechanism: the more a form of labour produces social complexity through resonance rather than through commodifiable output, the more hostile the system response becomes. The paper argues that the rise of AI and automation amplifies this conflict: since AI can simulate output but not resonance, contemporary labour policy rewards simulation and suppresses relational agency. As a result, societies risk destroying precisely the capacities they require for resilience and democratic self-correction. The paper concludes that a Universal Care Income is not a moral or humanitarian proposal but an epistemic infrastructure that enables relational labour to function as a stabilizing intelligence within complex societies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的劳动本体论，将工作定义为关系性能动（relational agency）而非市场产出。核心论点是资本主义经济不仅忽视非市场劳动形式（如艺术实践、护理工作、激进主义、深度自闭专注），而且结构性攻击它们，因为关系性劳动动摇了资本主义合法性的价值体系。通过艺术研究和神经多样性认知方法，作者将自闭的具身劳动概念化为高分辨率的系统分析模式。实证证据显示，当作者的自决劳动暴露制度功能障碍时，会遭到系统惩罚而非因拒绝工作。AI时代加剧了这一冲突，因为AI能模拟产出但不能模拟共鸣。论文主张普遍护理收入是使关系性劳动成为复杂社会稳定智能的认知基础设施。
AI.research_question: 资本主义经济如何对待非市场形式的关系性劳动（如艺术实践、护理工作、激进主义、自闭专注）？为什么系统会惩罚那些暴露制度功能障碍的自决劳动？
AI.motivation: 传统经济学将劳动定义为市场产出，忽视了非市场形式的关系性劳动（如艺术、护理、激进主义、自闭专注）。这些劳动形式对社会生态现实生成至关重要，但在资本主义体系中受到结构性攻击。需要重新定义劳动本体论，理解系统对关系性劳动的敌对反应机制。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 关系性劳动本体论：将工作定义为具身、自决的互动，通过共鸣生成社会和生态现实
2. 资本主义价值体系理论：资本主义合法性依赖于特定的价值制度
3. 神经多样性认知理论：自闭认知作为高分辨率系统分析模式
4. 艺术研究方法论：将艺术实践作为知识生产方式
5. 共鸣理论：社会复杂性通过共鸣而非商品化产出生成
AI.method:
1. 哲学论证：构建关系性劳动本体论框架
2. 艺术研究方法：将艺术实践作为认知方式
3. 神经多样性认知方法：利用自闭认知作为系统分析工具
4. 自民族志田野研究：基于10年在德国国家机构和公司环境中的亲身经历
5. 实证数据分析：将个人遭遇（行政制裁、官僚骚扰、法律压制）作为揭示一般机制的数据集
AI.findings:
1. 惩罚并非因拒绝工作而发生，而是当自决劳动暴露制度功能障碍时发生
2. 劳动形式产生的社会复杂性越多（通过共鸣而非商品化产出），系统反应越敌对
3. AI和自动化加剧了这一冲突：AI能模拟产出但不能模拟共鸣，导致政策奖励模拟而压制关系性能动
4. 系统攻击关系性劳动会破坏社会所需的韧性和民主自我修正能力
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 提出新的劳动本体论：将工作定义为关系性能动而非市场产出
2. 发展关系性劳动理论：解释资本主义对非市场劳动的结构性攻击
3. 建立自闭认知作为系统分析工具的理论框架
4. 将个人遭遇理论化为揭示系统机制的数据集而非个人不幸
5. 提出AI时代劳动冲突的新理论视角
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为理解系统对关系性劳动的敌对反应提供分析框架
2. 揭示AI和自动化如何加剧劳动价值冲突
3. 论证普遍护理收入（Universal Care Income）作为认知基础设施的必要性
4. 为政策制定者提供保护关系性劳动的制度设计思路
5. 为社会韧性和民主自我修正能力的保护提供实践指导

title: The MicroStrategy Trap: Why Your "Bitcoin Proxy" is Actually a Leveraged Bet
affiliations: Marquette University

detail.title: The MicroStrategy Trap: Why Your "Bitcoin Proxy" is Actually a Leveraged Bet

keywords: mNAV (Market Value to Net Asset Value)

detail.abstract: MicroStrategy (MSTR) is not a pure Bitcoin proxy but a highly leveraged corporate structure. The stock's market-to-net-asset-value (mNAV) is dangerously close to 1.00, threatening a "death spiral" if it drops below 1.00. This leverage creates up to 3x downside amplification compared to direct Bitcoin exposure, which was evident when a 17% BTC drop led to a 48% MSTR collapse. The paper concludes that MSTR is a leveraged bet, recommending institutional investors switch to unlevered spot Bitcoin ETFs.

AI.tldr: MicroStrategy (MSTR) 不是纯粹的比特币代理，而是一个高杠杆的公司结构。其市值与净资产比率(mNAV)接近1.00的危险水平，若跌破1.00将引发"死亡螺旋"。这种杠杆效应相比直接比特币敞口可能放大3倍下行风险，如17%的比特币下跌导致MSTR暴跌48%。论文建议机构投资者转向无杠杆的现货比特币ETF。
AI.research_question: MicroStrategy (MSTR) 作为比特币投资工具的风险特征是什么？其杠杆结构如何影响投资者相对于直接比特币敞口的风险收益特征？
AI.motivation: 许多投资者将MSTR视为比特币的代理投资，但忽视了其作为高杠杆公司结构的独特风险。当MSTR的市值与净资产比率(mNAV)接近1.00时，存在"死亡螺旋"风险，可能导致投资者损失远超过比特币本身的下跌幅度。
AI.theoretical_framework: 公司财务理论（杠杆效应、资本结构）、投资组合理论（风险放大效应）、市场微观结构理论（死亡螺旋机制）
AI.method: 实证分析（比较MSTR与比特币的价格关系）、财务比率分析（mNAV计算）、风险量化分析（下行放大倍数计算）
AI.findings: 1. MSTR的mNAV接近1.00，处于危险水平；2. MSTR的杠杆结构可放大下行风险达3倍；3. 实证显示17%的比特币下跌导致MSTR暴跌48%；4. MSTR不是纯粹的比特币代理，而是带有公司特定风险的杠杆赌注。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 揭示了将公司股票作为加密货币代理投资的风险特征；2. 提出了mNAV作为评估加密货币相关公司风险的关键指标；3. 量化了公司杠杆结构对加密货币敞口的风险放大效应。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 警告投资者MSTR的高杠杆风险；2. 建议机构投资者转向无杠杆的现货比特币ETF；3. 提供评估加密货币相关公司投资风险的分析框架；4. 帮助投资者理解公司结构对加密货币投资的影响。

title: Post-Conflict "Victory Diplomacy": Azerbaijan's "West Azerbaijan" Strategic Discourse and International Legitimacy
affiliations: University of Messina

detail.title: Post-Conflict "Victory Diplomacy": Azerbaijan's "West Azerbaijan" Strategic Discourse and International Legitimacy

declarations.declarationOfInterest: I declare no personal, financial, or professional conflicts of interest. This research was conducted independently as part of academic studies at the University of Messina. No external funding or institutional pressure influenced the research process or conclusions.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This documentary research analyzes publicly available diplomatic communications, official statements, and historical sources. No human subjects were involved, and all materials are in the public domain. The study complies with academic integrity standards and requires no formal ethics approval under applicable guidelines.
declarations.funderStatement: This study received no external funding. Research was self-funded by the author using publicly accessible resources and academic materials available through University of Messina facilities.

detail.abstract: This paper examines Azerbaijan's strategic employment of the "West Azerbaijan" discourse following the 2020 Second Karabakh War. Through analysis of diplomatic statements, legal references, and policy implementations from 2020 to 2024, the research demonstrates how historical references to territories within modern Armenia-specifically Zangezur, Goycha, and Irevan-have been systematically transformed into instruments of what this study terms "victory diplomacy." The discourse serves multiple functions: as psychological extension of military success, as negotiation leverage in peace talks, and as normative reconstruction of regional historical narratives¹. Legal examination focuses on Azerbaijan's invocation of 19th-century treaties alongside contemporary international law principles, particularly the tension between historical claims and the uti possidetis juris doctrine². Findings indicate that while the discourse effectively advances short-term diplomatic objectives, its long-term impact on Armenia-Azerbaijan normalization remains ambivalent, simultaneously creating pathways for addressing historical grievances and risks for diplomatic stagnation³.

AI.tldr: 本文研究阿塞拜疆在2020年第二次卡拉巴赫战争后如何战略性地运用"西阿塞拜疆"话语，将其作为"胜利外交"工具，通过历史领土主张（赞格祖尔、戈伊恰、伊雷万）实现心理优势、谈判杠杆和历史叙事重构，但长期对亚美尼亚-阿塞拜疆关系正常化影响存在矛盾。
AI.research_question: 阿塞拜疆如何在2020年第二次卡拉巴赫战争后战略性地运用"西阿塞拜疆"话语，以及这种话语如何作为"胜利外交"工具服务于其外交目标？
AI.motivation: 研究阿塞拜疆在军事胜利后如何将历史领土主张转化为外交工具，填补关于后冲突时期话语战略如何影响和平进程的研究空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 胜利外交理论、话语分析、国际法中的历史主张与uti possidetis juris原则的张力、冲突后外交战略。
AI.method: 对2020-2024年间阿塞拜疆的外交声明、法律引用和政策实施进行内容分析，结合19世纪条约和当代国际法原则的文本分析。
AI.findings: "西阿塞拜疆"话语具有多重功能：军事胜利的心理延伸、和平谈判的杠杆作用、地区历史叙事的规范性重构。该话语在短期内有效推进外交目标，但对亚美尼亚-阿塞拜疆关系正常化的长期影响存在矛盾，既为解决历史不满创造了途径，也带来了外交停滞的风险。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"胜利外交"概念框架，丰富了冲突后外交战略理论；展示了历史话语如何被系统性地转化为当代外交工具；深化了对国际法中历史主张与领土现状原则张力的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了理解阿塞拜疆外交战略的框架；揭示了历史话语在外交谈判中的实际运用机制；为国际调解者提供了评估冲突后和平进程复杂性的分析工具。

title: Expectation Inflation of Artificial Intelligence: When Human Demands on AI Exceed Moral Design Capacity

detail.title: Expectation Inflation of Artificial Intelligence: When Human Demands on AI Exceed Moral Design Capacity
detail.abstract: What happens when the ethical and interpretive standards that organisations and societies have for artificial intelligence (AI) exceed what it was originally designed to do? This paper presents Expectation Inflation as a conceptual framework for explaining how ethical risk in AI arises not from technical failures but from inflated human expectations and the excessive transfer of moral responsibility. Expectation Inflation captures the widening gap between human expectations and the actual capabilities of AI systems, which lack intention or conscience. Drawing on perspectives from Science and Technology Studies (STS), behavioural economics, and moral philosophy, the paper describes this phenomenon using the Expectation Inflation Curve, which includes three stages: Rational Delegation, Normative Drift, and Moral Substitution. It introduces Moral Design Capacity (MDC) as the point at which the delegated authority ceases to be ethically valid. To realign expectations, the paper suggests Expectation Governance, a framework encompassing three elements: Delegation Boundaries (limits on moral authority), Expectation Auditing (tracking for exaggerated expectations), and Moral Accountability Indexing (reestablishing ethical ownership). These approaches aim to manage moral over-delegation effectively. The study reinterprets AI ethics as a matter of maintaining moral balance instead of solely correcting algorithms, and highlights the importance of leadership in sustaining this equilibrium. By redefining AI governance as the management of moral expectations, the paper establishes a new research direction for exploring the dynamics of expectations in ethical scenarios. This framework allows organisations to identify and address moral risks linked with AI implementation, foster ethical resilience, and preserve leadership integrity in data-driven decision-making.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了"期望膨胀"概念框架，解释AI伦理风险源于人类期望过高和道德责任过度转移，而非技术故障。论文引入期望膨胀曲线、道德设计能力等概念，并提出期望治理框架来管理道德过度委托。
AI.research_question: 当组织和社会的AI伦理与解释标准超出AI原始设计能力时会发生什么？AI伦理风险如何源于人类期望膨胀而非技术失败？
AI.motivation: 当前AI伦理讨论过于关注技术修正，而忽视了人类期望与AI实际能力之间的差距如何导致道德风险。需要重新思考AI伦理作为道德平衡问题而非单纯算法修正。
AI.theoretical_framework: 科学和技术研究(STS)、行为经济学、道德哲学；期望膨胀概念、道德设计能力(MDC)、期望膨胀曲线（理性委托、规范漂移、道德替代三阶段）
AI.method: 概念框架开发，理论分析，基于多学科视角构建理论模型
AI.findings: AI伦理风险主要源于人类期望膨胀和道德责任过度转移；期望膨胀曲线描述了从理性委托到道德替代的演变过程；道德设计能力是委托权威不再具有伦理效力的临界点
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出"期望膨胀"作为解释AI伦理风险的新概念框架；2. 引入道德设计能力概念界定伦理委托边界；3. 将AI伦理重新定义为道德平衡问题而非算法修正；4. 建立期望治理作为AI治理的新研究方向
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提供期望治理框架（委托边界、期望审计、道德责任索引）；2. 帮助组织识别和管理AI实施中的道德风险；3. 促进伦理韧性建设；4. 维护数据驱动决策中的领导力完整性

title: What Drives the Performance of Machine Learning Factor Strategies?
affiliations: Scientific Beta and Scientific Beta

detail.title: What Drives the Performance of Machine Learning Factor Strategies?
detail.abstract: Machine learning factor models of the cross section of stock returns have produced spectacular results, which are explained by two different ingredients: expanding the information set and allowing for more flexible function forms. We disentangle the value-added of each ingredient, considering a variety of empirical settings: from highly stylised to realistic. We show that the benefit of both ingredients declines when moving from standard settings in the literature to more realistic settings that exclude microcaps, remove look-ahead bias on yet-to-be-published factors, account for transaction costs, and exclude short positions. While the value of nonlinearity disappears even before imposing transaction costs or short-sale constraints, the value of an expanded information set is more persistent. Our feature importance analysis reveals that characteristics like firm size and short-term reversal - crucial predictors in standard settings - lose most of their value once investability constraints are considered. These findings challenge claims about the universal benefits of machine learning sophistication, demonstrating that real-world implementation constraints fundamentally alter which model ingredients improve portfolio performance.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现，机器学习因子模型在股票横截面收益预测中的优异表现主要来自两个要素：信息集扩展和更灵活的函数形式。但在考虑现实投资约束（排除微型股、避免前瞻偏差、考虑交易成本、排除空头头寸）后，这两个要素的价值显著下降，非线性要素的价值甚至完全消失。
AI.research_question: 机器学习因子模型在股票横截面收益预测中的优异表现，究竟有多少来自信息集扩展，多少来自更灵活的函数形式？这些要素在现实投资约束下的价值如何变化？
AI.motivation: 现有文献显示机器学习因子模型在股票收益预测方面表现优异，但未清楚区分其成功是源于信息集扩展还是非线性函数形式，也未充分考虑现实投资约束对这些要素价值的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 资产定价理论、机器学习理论、投资组合理论、市场微观结构理论
AI.method: 采用多种实证设定：从高度程式化到现实情境，逐步引入约束条件（排除微型股、消除前瞻偏差、考虑交易成本、排除空头头寸），比较不同模型成分的价值变化，并进行特征重要性分析。
AI.findings: 1. 信息集扩展和非线性函数形式的价值在现实约束下显著下降；2. 非线性要素的价值在考虑交易成本或空头约束前就已消失；3. 信息集扩展的价值更具持续性；4. 公司规模和短期反转等关键预测因子在投资可行性约束下失去大部分价值。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次系统区分了机器学习因子模型中信息集扩展和函数形式灵活性的相对贡献；2. 揭示了现实投资约束如何从根本上改变模型要素的价值；3. 挑战了关于机器学习复杂性能带来普遍益处的观点。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为投资者提供了更现实的模型评估框架；2. 指出在现实约束下应更关注信息集扩展而非模型复杂性；3. 识别了在投资可行性约束下仍保持预测价值的特征；4. 帮助避免过度依赖在理想化设定下表现优异但在现实中无效的策略。

detail.title: Investment Dynamics and Merger Policy: Long-run Effects of Horizontal Merger in Oligopolistic Market
detail.abstract: This paper evaluates long-run effects of a horizontal merger and its remedies in a capital-intensive industry. It estimates a dynamic oligopoly model with continuous investment, enabled by a computationally efficient simulation algorithm. A decomposition of investment incentives shows that static forces dominated dynamic considerations. The merger, despite raising prices, increased social welfare, primarily through efficiency gains. The analysis also finds that divestiture remedies had persistent effects lasting nearly two decades, and that optimal remedy design differs markedly depending on whether consumer or social welfare is used as the evaluative standard.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估了资本密集型行业横向并购及其救济措施的长期影响，发现尽管并购导致价格上涨，但效率提升使社会福利增加，而剥离救济措施的效果持续近20年，且最优救济设计取决于采用消费者福利还是社会福利标准。
AI.research_question: 资本密集型行业中横向并购及其救济措施的长期效应是什么？并购如何影响价格、效率和社会福利？救济措施（特别是剥离）的持久性如何？最优救济设计在不同福利标准下有何差异？
AI.motivation: 资本密集型行业的并购影响评估通常忽视长期动态效应，特别是投资激励的变化。现有研究多关注静态分析，缺乏对救济措施长期效果的实证评估，且不同福利标准下的政策设计差异尚未充分探讨。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态寡头竞争理论、连续投资模型、并购效应分解理论（静态力量vs动态考量）、社会福利与消费者福利权衡理论、救济措施持久性理论。
AI.method: 采用计算高效的模拟算法估计连续投资的动态寡头模型，对投资激励进行分解分析，评估并购和救济措施的长期效应，比较不同福利标准下的最优救济设计。
AI.findings: 1. 并购虽提高价格但通过效率提升增加社会福利；2. 静态力量主导投资激励，动态考量相对次要；3. 剥离救济措施效果持续近20年；4. 最优救济设计在消费者福利和社会福利标准下差异显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 发展了资本密集型行业并购长期效应的动态分析框架；2. 提出投资激励的静态-动态分解方法；3. 揭示了不同福利标准下救济设计的内在冲突；4. 为并购救济措施的持久性评估提供理论依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为反垄断机构提供长期动态评估并购的工具；2. 指导救济措施设计，特别是剥离的长期效果预期；3. 明确消费者福利与社会福利标准的政策选择意义；4. 为资本密集型行业并购审查提供实证参考。

title: Interpret Industrial Chain with Hermitian Graph Neural Network
affiliations: Southwestern University of Finance and Economics (SWUFE), Southwestern University of Finance and Economics, The University of Hong Kong - Department of Statistics and Actuarial Science and Southwestern University of Finance and Economics

detail.title: Interpret Industrial Chain with Hermitian Graph Neural Network
detail.abstract: The industrial chain constitutes a heterogeneous graph with a mixture of directed and undirected edges, featuring both coarsegrained industry nodes and fine-grained product nodes. In the industrial chain structure, the relationships between industry nodes and product nodes are undirected, while those between product nodes are directed. This presents significant challenges for conventional heterogeneous graph neural networks in modeling the industrial chain data. To overcome these challenges, we define demand and supply attributes for all nodes and propose a heterogeneous graph message aggregation algorithm based on the Hermitian adjacency matrix. Our approach facilitates the concurrent updating of two attribute types while maximizing the likelihood of the mixed graph. Our proposed model can quantify the mixed propagation process of ESG (Environmental, Social and Governance) impacts within the industrial chain, enabling precise analysis of the influence of sustainability on the industrial chain.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于厄米特邻接矩阵的异构图消息聚合算法，用于建模产业链中混合有向和无向边的异构图结构，以量化ESG影响在产业链中的混合传播过程。

AI.motivation: 产业链构成包含粗粒度行业节点和细粒度产品节点的异构图，其中行业节点与产品节点之间为无向边，产品节点之间为有向边。这种混合图结构给传统异构图神经网络带来了建模挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于厄米特邻接矩阵的异构图消息聚合算法，为所有节点定义需求和供应属性，同时更新两种属性类型并最大化混合图的似然。
AI.method: 提出基于厄米特邻接矩阵的异构图消息聚合算法，处理产业链中混合有向和无向边的异构图结构，量化ESG影响的混合传播过程。
AI.findings: 所提模型能够量化ESG影响在产业链中的混合传播过程，实现对可持续性对产业链影响的精确分析。

detail.abstract: Despite record capital expenditure (CapEx) on Artificial Intelligence technologies within the global healthcare sector, the realized Return on Investment (ROI) remains paradoxically low. Hospital operating margins continue to compress, and clinician productivity has not seen the promised "J-Curve" expansion. This paper investigates the root cause of this "Productivity Paradox," proposing that the failure is not algorithmic but organizational. We introduce the concept of "Transactional Friction," arguing that deploying AI tools into fragmented, legacy workflows creates negative economies of scale. By analyzing the "Hidden Integration Tax" of isolated AI solutions, this study demonstrates that efficiency cannot be purchased; it must be architected. We conclude that without fundamental workflow re-engineering, AI investment serves only to accelerate existing inefficiencies, leading to an "ROI Mirage.

AI.tldr: 尽管全球医疗保健领域在人工智能技术上投入了创纪录的资本支出，但实现的投资回报率却低得反常。本文认为失败原因不是算法问题而是组织问题，提出了"交易摩擦"概念，指出将AI工具部署到碎片化的遗留工作流程中会产生负规模经济。

AI.motivation: 全球医疗保健部门在人工智能技术上投入了创纪录的资本支出，但医院运营利润率持续压缩，临床医生生产力并未出现预期的"J曲线"增长，存在明显的"生产力悖论"。
AI.theoretical_framework: "交易摩擦"概念、"负规模经济"理论、"隐藏整合税"概念、"ROI幻象"概念。
AI.method: 通过分析孤立AI解决方案的"隐藏整合税"，研究AI工具部署到碎片化、遗留工作流程中的影响。
AI.findings: 将AI工具部署到碎片化的遗留工作流程中会产生负规模经济，效率无法购买而必须通过架构设计实现。没有根本性的工作流程重新设计，AI投资只会加速现有低效率。

detail.abstract:
Infrastructure systems in the United States are increasingly exposed to concurrent threats, including climate-induced disasters, cyber intrusions, and aging assets, that strain response capacity and long-term resilience planning. Traditional emergency-management frameworks rely on descriptive reporting rather than predictive, data-driven insight. Emerging data-analytics capabilities now enable agencies to forecast vulnerabilities, optimize resource allocation, and coordinate inter-jurisdictional response with greater precision.

This paper examines how predictive analytics and integrated data-governance models can strengthen national preparedness across transportation, utilities, and public-safety networks. It analyzes federal initiatives, highlights sector-specific technology applications, and proposes a unified governance structure for sustainable resilience investment.

Case studies drawn from wildfire management, flood-mitigation programs, energy-sector cybersecurity, and urban climate-resilience planning demonstrate measurable gains in response time, situational accuracy, and operational efficiency.

The paper concludes by outlining a national policy roadmap emphasizing interoperability, cybersecurity, standardized data protocols, and workforce-capacity development, core components needed to transform fragmented resilience practices into a cohesive, analytics-driven emergency-management ecosystem.

affiliations: Samford University - Brock School of Business

detail.title: Commercialization and Mission-Drift in the Nonprofit Sector
detail.abstract: This paper models the nonprofit organization as a multi-sided platform connecting donors, clients, and beneficiaries, while deriving a unified economic theory of mission drift. We establish a marginal entry rule for commercialization, identifying that organizations should expand into commercial markets only if net marginal cash (the sum of direct commercial margin, donor reaction, and administrative drag) is positive. This framework resolves a long-standing empirical paradox by formally distinguishing mission share (the ratio of program expenses to total revenue) from mission impact (the absolute level of charitable output). Using a panel of 3.46 million organization-years from IRS Form 990 data covering 2012 to 2021, we find that commercialization is associated with a significant decline in mission share but a substantial increase in absolute mission impact. This divergence implies that declining efficiency ratios, often interpreted as evidence of drift, frequently reflect accounting artifacts rather than mission abandonment. We further document a starvation trap dynamic. While commercialization lifts mission impact on average, resource-constrained organizations realize significantly lower marginal gains than their well-capitalized peers, suggesting that the capacity to cross-subsidize is conditional on financial health.

AI.tldr: 该研究将非营利组织建模为连接捐赠者、客户和受益人的多边平台，提出了统一的使命漂移经济理论。研究发现商业化会降低使命份额（项目支出占总收入比例），但会显著增加绝对使命影响，解决了长期存在的实证悖论。

1. 多边平台理论：将非营利组织建模为连接捐赠者、客户和受益人的平台

detail.abstract: The military decision-making process (MDMP) is a systematic, iterative approach developed to analyze complex situations and formulate effective operational plans. Despite existing AI tools at the general staff level, a significant gap persists at the battalion level, where such automated systems are virtually nonexistent, presenting a window for efficiency increases. This paper presents our investigation into addressing this deficiency by developing a text-based AI tool aimed at automating the Course of Action (CoA) development step of the MDMP process specifically for battalion-level planning. The methodology employed involved understanding operational requirements, constructing a tailored AI model, and examining the model's capabilities against real-world tactical scenarios. Our findings show nuanced results. While our solution demonstrates potential in streamlining plan generation for specific scenarios, it also exposes limitations inherent in current large language models (LLMs), including issues with data interpretation, integration, and the generation of consistent outputs. Challenges faced included the lack of robust inclusion or output with visual graphics. These findings caution the use of AI planning tools in their current state and propose recommendations for future research that advocate for enhancements in model training on domain-specific datasets and the integration of visual data, which could elevate the effectiveness of AI in military planning contexts. The insights derived from our exploration contribute to a foundational understanding of AI's role in military operations and pave the way for further advancements in automated tactical decision-making frameworks. (Work performed between September 2024 and May 2025)

detail.abstract: Purpose-driven organizations build from powerful ideas, but sustaining those ideals over time is ultimately a balancing act between mission and execution. In this case study we explore the growth and trajectory of Solara Innovations, a fictional enterprise built on a regenerative vision to "engineer a world without waste" and architected to promote Purpose culture at all levels. Solara is ultimately the epitome of Purpose-led enterprisecentered around a visionary leader leading the charge, rooted in stewardship and inquiry, built on trust and autonomy, and supported through values-aligned rituals, governance measures, and impact metrics. And for many years, Solara delivers the promises of Purpose culture: great engagement, breakthrough innovation and loyal stakeholders paired with a clear view and approach to success that extends long beyond business returns. The only thing Solara has to deal with over time is the predictable frustrations that will set in when Purpose-driven organizations grow older. These tensions are exacerbated by external pressures, slow decision-making, internal strains and the limitations of idealism in the face of changing economic and political reality. Ultimately, the organization is driven to change the way it operates, moving toward a "mature purpose culture" that joins disciplined execution with the long-term purpose. The journey represented by Solara demonstrates the perennial challenge of aligning purpose with performance, providing a compelling lens on how purpose can act at once as a North Star and a practical framework for navigating complexity.

detail.title: Developing A Corporate Sustainability Management Strategy: The Case of FPT Corporation
detail.abstract: In the global shift toward sustainability and green transition, corporate sustainability reporting has become a strategic tool to enhance transparency, competitiveness, and access to sustainable finance. This paper aims to assess the current state of FPT Corporation’s ESG disclosure and propose strategies for improvement aligned with international standards. The study employs a qualitative design that combines secondary data analysis and in-depth inquiry: FPT’s 2024 ESG Report disclosures and IBM’s 2023 Sustainability Report were analyzed using the GRI Standards (2021) and a benchmarking matrix, while semi-structured interviews with FPT managers and specialists provided additional insights into internal perceptions and challenges. Findings reveal that FPT’s reporting remains largely qualitative, with limited quantitative indicators, supply chain data, and independent assurance, although progress has been made through the establishment of an ESG task force and the adoption of digital tools. The study recommends a roadmap based on the ESG Maturity Model, emphasizing standardized reporting, digitalization, and governance reforms to strengthen ESG maturity and position FPT as a sustainability leader in Vietnam’s technology sector.

detail.abstract: The art of structuring event data in such a way that it fully empowers process mining analysis, is currently only within reach after labor and time intensive trial and error. This paper reports on a procedure that can be followed to build such an event log for process mining purposes and aims to accelerate this learning curve. It intends to create awareness of the decisions an event log builder takes and its related consequences. The procedure consists out of seven steps and is written in the form of a manual for the event log builder. The report is based on nine years of process mining experience in both academics and industry by the author.

title: Reflecting on Reflective Loss
affiliations: National University of Singapore (NUS) - Faculty of Law

detail.title: Reflecting on Reflective Loss
detail.abstract: In Commonwealth jurisdictions, the reflective loss doctrine bars shareholders from recovering damages that overlap with the company's own losses. In this article, I locate the doctrine's theoretical foundations in liquidation protection-the rules that shield corporate assets from unilateral withdrawals, thereby facilitating capital lock-in and long-term investment. Although these rules offer clear benefits, they also carry costs, including the risk of controller opportunism. Drawing on a Law & Economics framework, I argue that, while the question of how best to tailor the rule to manage these trade-offs depends on empirical considerations, the notion that shareholders have voluntarily subordinated their claims to those of the company provides a robust response to these considerations, and in turn offers a strong justification for the existence of the doctrine. Nevertheless, I propose that factors such as the derivative action regime and conflict-of-interest constraints can help refine the rule's application. I also examine whether creditors should face a similar bar on overlapping losses, focusing on whether they voluntarily subordinate their claims in a manner analogous to shareholders. By engaging with recent legal developments, including Sevilleja v Marex Financial Ltd [2020] UKSC 31, I aim to provide a nuanced perspective on how liquidation protection shapes incentives under evolving reflective loss rules.

title: Multidimensional Injustice and Systemic Urban Crisis: Youth Perspectives from African Cities

detail.title: Multidimensional Injustice and Systemic Urban Crisis: Youth Perspectives from African Cities
detail.abstract: Growing attention to the multidimensional nature of urban crises, as evidenced by the increasing use of the concept of polycrisis, highlights the systemic and interconnected nature of risks and vulnerabilities. However, the relationship between the multiple dimensions of risk and the multi-faceted nature of underlying urban injustices are still in need of unpacking. Of particular interest, and significantly understudied, is the experience of African youth in informal settlements and the effects that interconnected crises have on them in contexts of systemic marginalisation. Using the COVID-19 pandemic is one example of an urban crisis that exposed the compounded effects of structurally linked inequalities embedded within our socio-economic and political systems, this study applied a multidimensional injustice framework and a systemic risk lens to unpack youth perspectives on the nature of urban crisis. Data collected in collaboration between youth members of Slum Dwellers International across eight African cities, Slum Dwellers International professional staff, and researchers from the UK used a co-produced rapid assessment methodology suitable for grounding epistemic justice in crisis conditions. This study found that the compounding challenges faced by young people across urban Africa call for (i) approaches to urban resilience that address the distributional and procedural injustices that transform manageable risks into devastating crises, and (ii) centring youth perspectives and their capacity to generate contextually responsive solutions.

title: A Multi-Perspective Analysis of Electrifying South Africa's Minibus Taxi Fleet: Energy, Environmental, and Operator Impacts
affiliations: Stellenbosch University, Stellenbosch University, Stellenbosch University, University of Pretoria, University of Pretoria and Stellenbosch University - Faculty of Engineering

detail.title: A Multi-Perspective Analysis of Electrifying South Africa's Minibus Taxi Fleet: Energy, Environmental, and Operator Impacts
detail.abstract: The minibus taxi is the dominant mode of public transport in South Africa, serving approximately 65% of daily commuters. As global momentum toward electric vehicles (EVs) accelerates, understanding the implications of electrifying this sector is critical for achieving sustainable transport goals. This paper presents a comprehensive multi-perspective analysis of the energy, environmental, and operator impacts of transitioning South Africa’s minibus taxi fleet to electric vehicles. Using high-resolution tracking data from two independent datasets, we evaluate the daily energy demand for charging electric minibus taxis (eMBTs), assess greenhouse gas (GHG) and particulate matter (PM) emissions under South Africa’s coal-dominated electricity grid, and analyse the total cost of ownership (TCO) for vehicle operators. Our findings indicate that while electrification can lead to significant reductions in tailpipe emissions, the overall environmental benefits are contingent on grid decarbonisation efforts. Additionally, the financial analysis reveals that despite higher upfront costs, eMBTs can offer lower operational costs over their lifespan, making them economically viable for operators under certain conditions. This study provides critical insights for policymakers, stakeholders, and industry players considering the electrification of paratransit systems in developing regions.

AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者、利益相关者和行业参与者提供了关键见解，支持发展中国家半公共交通系统电动化的决策制定。

title: Tying and Bundling in Digital Markets under the European Union Competition Law and Digital Markets Act
affiliations: Lund University

detail.title: Tying and Bundling in Digital Markets under the European Union Competition Law and Digital Markets Act

contentType.other: Master Thesis, available online at Lund University student papers open database

detail.abstract: The Digital Markets Act, which came into force and its rules became applicable to undertakings deemed to have gatekeeper status operating in the European Union's digital markets, has caused significant controversy in the literature. One of the widely held concerns is that most of the DMAs’ conduct rules are the same as the equivalent obligations dealing with the same practices under the EU Competition Law. However, this statement was never backed up by sufficient analysis that is needed. This work attempted to conduct an analysis of the rules governing tying and bundling practices in digital markets under both the DMA and EU Competition Law. The main purpose of this thesis is to identify where the DMA’s rules governing tying and bundling practices constitute substitute or complementary effects to the EU Competition Law by comparing available obligations and prohibitions under both systems. For this purpose, this work will first analyse the rules governing tying and bundling under the EU Competition Law, both in traditional and digital markets. While scrutinizing tying and bundling under the EU Competition Law, this work will shed specific light on economic theories and studies on tying and bundling to have a better understanding of these concepts and their legal regulation, alongside their definition and classification. Then, this work will turn to scrutinize the DMA’s provisions related to tying and bundling and institutionally analyse the DMA. To enable us to answer the main thesis question, the discussions will also extend to differentiating the DMA and EU Competition Law together with the distinctiveness of the goals of the two legal systems in question. Answering the main thesis question brings about two main issues. The first one is that if there is the same set of rules aimed at governing the same illegal practices, this can possibly bring about discussions on the application of double jeopardy. Thus, this work will discuss the possibility of the limitations to the ne bis in idem principle while the DMA and EU Competition Law are concerned with tying and bundling practices. Secondly, it will be observed that while analysing the economics of tying and bundling, these practices can also be pro-competitive, and EU Competition Law leaves possible space for such effects since efficiency claims are available under it, being different from the DMA. Therefore, it will be discussed what can happen to the innovative effects of tying and bundling under the DMA.

AI.tldr: 本文通过比较《数字市场法案》和欧盟竞争法对搭售和捆绑行为的规制，分析两者是替代还是互补关系，并探讨双重追诉原则适用性和创新影响问题。
AI.research_question: 《数字市场法案》中关于搭售和捆绑行为的规则与欧盟竞争法中的相应规定构成替代还是互补关系？
AI.motivation: 《数字市场法案》生效后引发争议，其中一个主要担忧是其行为规则与欧盟竞争法中对相同行为的规制高度相似，但缺乏充分分析支持这一观点。
AI.theoretical_framework: 搭售和捆绑的经济学理论、欧盟竞争法框架、数字市场规制理论、双重追诉原则（ne bis in idem）
AI.method: 比较分析法：首先分析欧盟竞争法下传统和数字市场中搭售和捆绑的规制规则，结合经济学理论和研究；然后审视《数字市场法案》相关条款并进行制度分析；最后通过比较两个法律体系的目标和规则差异来回答研究问题。
AI.findings: 研究发现两个主要问题：1）相同规则针对相同非法行为可能引发双重追诉原则适用性问题；2）搭售和捆绑行为可能具有促进竞争效应，欧盟竞争法通过效率抗辩为此留出空间，而《数字市场法案》则不同，这会影响创新效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 理论贡献：1）首次系统比较《数字市场法案》和欧盟竞争法在搭售和捆绑规制方面的关系；2）探讨数字市场规制中双重追诉原则的适用边界；3）分析不同法律框架对创新激励的影响机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 实践贡献：1）为监管机构提供两个法律体系协调适用的指导；2）帮助企业理解合规要求差异；3）为政策制定者完善数字市场规制框架提供参考。

title: The Term Structure of Risk in Private Equities
affiliations: EDHEC Business School, EDHEC Business School and

detail.title: The Term Structure of Risk in Private Equities

declarations.funderStatement: The research was supported by data from EDHEC Infra and Private Assets Research Institute, Singapore.

detail.abstract: This paper provides the first empirical evidence on the term structure of volatility in private markets, focusing on private equities. Using quarterly data from 2013-2024, we estimate a Bayesian VAR to model horizon-dependent risk while accounting for small-sample and parameter uncertainty. Volatility term structure slopes downward, consistent with mean reversion, yet private equities remain more volatile than public markets at all horizons, challenging the view that illiquidity reduces long-run risk. Portfolio analysis shows that private equities can enhance diversification, but fees, illiquidity, and investor risk aversion substantially reduce optimal allocations. These results caution against interpreting private equities as long-horizon safe assets and offer implications for strategic portfolio design.

AI.tldr: 该研究首次实证分析了私募股权市场的波动率期限结构，发现其呈向下倾斜（均值回归），但所有期限的波动率仍高于公开市场，挑战了流动性不足会降低长期风险的观点。投资组合分析显示私募股权能增强分散化，但费用、流动性不足和投资者风险厌恶显著降低了最优配置比例。
AI.research_question: 私募股权市场的波动率期限结构特征是什么？私募股权相对于公开市场的长期风险如何？私募股权在投资组合中的最优配置比例受哪些因素影响？
AI.motivation: 缺乏对私募市场波动率期限结构的实证证据；需要理解私募股权作为长期资产的真实风险特征；投资者对私募股权作为"长期安全资产"的误解需要澄清。
AI.theoretical_framework: 波动率期限结构理论；均值回归理论；资产定价理论；投资组合理论；流动性溢价理论。
AI.method: 使用2013-2024年季度数据；采用贝叶斯向量自回归（BVAR）模型；考虑小样本和参数不确定性；进行投资组合优化分析。
AI.findings: 1. 私募股权波动率期限结构向下倾斜，符合均值回归特征；2. 但所有期限的波动率仍高于公开市场；3. 流动性不足并未降低长期风险；4. 私募股权能增强投资组合分散化；5. 费用、流动性不足和风险厌恶显著降低最优配置比例。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提供私募市场波动率期限结构的实证证据；挑战了"流动性不足降低长期风险"的传统观点；完善了私募资产定价理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 警示投资者不应将私募股权视为长期安全资产；为投资组合战略设计提供实证依据；帮助投资者更理性地评估私募股权的风险和收益特征。

title: Who CARES? Airline Quality and the Aftermath of the CARES Act
affiliations: University of Oklahoma - Department of Economics

detail.title: Who CARES? Airline Quality and the Aftermath of the CARES Act
detail.abstract: Questions regarding the effectiveness of different subsidies, along with the efficiency and stability they may provide, have been researched widely within the field of economics. However, the effects that result from the conclusion of subsidization have received considerably less attention. As a case study, this analysis focuses on the CARES Act subsidy and its influence on the airline industry. The CARES Act, implemented in March 2020, provided funding for airlines amidst the COVID-19 pandemic. The funding consisted of a twenty-five billion dollar allotment from the government across all airlines, which was awarded based on the preceding year's employment costs. This paper examines whether this act led to improvements in quality or productivity within the airline industry after the initial CARES Act shock subsided. Binary regression methods and on-time performance data are utilized to this end. Ultimately, I find that, by my most conservative estimates, the CARES Act's resolution led to decreased quality, with a dip in worker productivity.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了CARES法案补贴结束后对航空业的影响，发现补贴终止导致航空服务质量下降和工人生产力降低。
AI.research_question: CARES法案补贴结束后是否改善了航空业的质量或生产力？
AI.motivation: 经济学领域广泛研究了不同补贴的有效性、效率和稳定性，但补贴结束后的影响却很少受到关注。本研究以CARES法案为例，探讨补贴终止对航空业的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于补贴经济学理论，特别是关于政府补贴对产业绩效影响的理论框架，关注补贴结束后可能产生的"后补贴效应"。
AI.method: 使用二元回归方法和准点率数据进行分析，以评估CARES法案补贴结束后航空业的质量和生产力变化。
AI.findings: 根据最保守的估计，CARES法案补贴结束后导致航空服务质量下降，工人生产力出现下滑。
AI.theory_contributions: 填补了补贴经济学中关于"补贴结束后效应"的研究空白，提供了补贴终止可能对产业产生负面影响的实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了重要启示：在设计补贴政策时需要考虑补贴结束后的过渡安排，避免产业在补贴终止后出现质量下降和生产力滑坡。

title: Banks and Capital Requirements: Evidence from Countercyclical Buffers
affiliations: Bank for International Settlements (BIS), Goethe University Frankfurt - Department of Finance, European Central Bank (ECB) and European Central Bank (ECB)

detail.title: Banks and Capital Requirements: Evidence from Countercyclical Buffers
detail.abstract: When capital requirements rise, banks can raise equity or reduce risk‑weighted assets, typically by cutting lending. We show they also use credit default swaps (CDS). Linking EU trade‑repository CDS data to syndicated loans for November 2017 to April 2024, we document that banks significantly increase CDS hedging on loans to firms in countries that raise their countercyclical capital buffer (CCyB). Our identification exploits within‑bank comparisons of hedging for similar borrowers across countries with different CCyB rates. A 1 percentage point increase in the CCyB reduces the uninsured share of a loan by about 53 percentage points, with the strongest effects for banks most exposed to the buffer‑raising country. Eligible credit risk transfer via CDS thus emerges as a first‑order channel through which banks accommodate tighter capital requirements, potentially attenuating macroprudential policy transmission.

AI.tldr: 研究发现，当资本要求提高时，银行不仅通过增发股权或减少风险加权资产（如削减贷款）来应对，还会显著增加使用信用违约互换（CDS）进行对冲。具体来说，当国家提高逆周期资本缓冲（CCyB）时，银行会增加对受影响国家企业贷款的CDS对冲，从而降低贷款的未保险比例。
AI.research_question: 银行如何通过信用违约互换（CDS）来应对资本要求的提高，特别是逆周期资本缓冲（CCyB）的变化？
AI.motivation: 传统上认为银行应对资本要求提高主要通过增发股权或减少风险加权资产（如削减贷款），但忽略了信用风险转移工具（如CDS）的作用。理解银行如何通过CDS对冲来应对资本要求变化，对于评估宏观审慎政策的传导效果至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于银行资本管理理论，银行在面临资本约束时会优化其资产负债表。引入信用风险转移工具（CDS）作为应对资本要求的替代渠道，扩展了传统资本监管传导机制的理论框架。
AI.method: 使用欧盟交易库的CDS数据与银团贷款数据（2017年11月至2024年4月）进行关联分析。采用银行内部比较的识别策略，比较同一银行对不同国家相似借款人的CDS对冲行为，利用各国CCyB利率的差异进行因果推断。
AI.findings: 当国家提高CCyB 1个百分点时，银行会显著增加对该国企业贷款的CDS对冲，使贷款的未保险比例降低约53个百分点。对受影响国家风险敞口最大的银行，这种效应最为明显。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统性地证明了CDS作为银行应对资本要求提高的重要渠道，挑战了传统认为银行主要通过削减贷款来应对资本约束的观点。为资本监管传导机制理论提供了新的微观证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 政策制定者需要认识到，银行通过CDS进行信用风险转移可能会削弱宏观审慎政策（如CCyB）的传导效果。监管机构在设计和评估资本监管政策时，应考虑银行使用衍生品进行风险转移的行为。

title: Learning from Crises: A New Class of Time-Varying Parameter Vars with Observable Adaptation
affiliations: and University of Glasgow - Adam Smith Business School

detail.title: Learning from Crises: A New Class of Time-Varying Parameter Vars with Observable Adaptation

declarations.declarationOfInterest: N/A
declarations.funderStatement: N/A

detail.abstract: We revisit macroeconomic time-varying parameter vector autoregressions (TVP-VARs), whose persistent coefficients may adapt too slowly to large, abrupt shifts such as those during major crises. We explore the performance of an adaptively-varying parameter (AVP) VAR that incorporates deterministic adjustments driven by observable exogenous variables, replacing latent state innovations with linear combinations of macroeconomic and financial indicators. This reformulation collapses the state equation into the measurement equation, enabling simple linear estimation of the model. Simulations show that adaptive parameters are substantially more parsimonious than conventional TVPs, effectively disciplining parameter dynamics without sacrificing flexibility. Using macroeconomic datasets for both the U.S. and the euro area, we demonstrate that AVP-VAR consistently improves out-of-sample forecasts, especially during periods of heightened volatility.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种自适应变参数VAR模型，用可观测外生变量驱动的确定性调整替代传统的时变参数VAR中的潜在状态创新，简化了模型估计并提高了预测性能。
AI.research_question: 如何改进传统的时变参数VAR模型，使其能更好地适应宏观经济中的大幅突变（如重大危机），同时保持参数动态的简洁性和预测准确性？
AI.motivation: 传统时变参数VAR模型的参数变化可能过于缓慢，难以适应重大危机期间的大幅突变，且参数动态复杂，估计困难。
AI.theoretical_framework: 时变参数向量自回归模型、自适应变参数VAR模型、状态空间模型重构理论。
AI.method: 提出自适应变参数VAR模型，用可观测的宏观经济和金融指标线性组合替代潜在状态创新，将状态方程融入测量方程，实现线性估计。通过模拟实验验证模型简洁性，并使用美国和欧元区宏观经济数据进行实证分析。
AI.findings: 自适应参数比传统时变参数更简洁，能有效约束参数动态而不牺牲灵活性；AVP-VAR在样本外预测中表现更优，特别是在高波动时期。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了将状态方程融入测量方程的新建模框架，简化了时变参数VAR的估计过程，为处理宏观经济突变提供了理论创新。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和研究人员提供了更简洁、更准确的宏观经济预测工具，特别适用于危机时期的高波动环境预测。

title: Revisiting the Price Elasticity of Charitable Giving: Meta-Analysis of Tax Incentives and Matching Donations
affiliations: The University of Osaka - Institute of Social and Economic Research, University of Osaka,  and University of Osaka

detail.title: Revisiting the Price Elasticity of Charitable Giving: Meta-Analysis of Tax Incentives and Matching Donations

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no financial or other conflicts of interest.
declarations.funderStatement: The authors acknowledge financial support from the Japan Society for the Promotion of Science (KAKENHI No. JP25K16598 to G-J.C., No. JP24K00264 to S.S. and G-J.C., No. JP25H00388 to S.S. and T.I., No. JP22K21358 to T.I.).

detail.abstract: This paper presents the first quantitative meta-analysis of the price elasticity of charitable giving under both rebate and matching schemes. We compile 151 elasticity estimates from 33 experimental studies and synthesize them using random-effects and multi-level models. Charitable giving is highly price-responsive: the pooled meta-analytic mean elasticity of total donations is-1.25, indicating that lowering the effective price of giving substantially increases charitable revenue. Although we observe considerable between-study heterogeneity and some evidence of publication bias, bias-adjusted estimates remain negative. Furthermore, elasticity is substantially more negative under matching (-1.98) than under rebate (-0.87), contradicting the theoretical prediction of equivalence but aligning with the original experimental findings in this literature. The rebate-matching difference is attenuated when moving from laboratory to field settings, although it persists.

AI.tldr: 本文首次对慈善捐赠在返利和匹配两种方案下的价格弹性进行了定量元分析，发现慈善捐赠对价格高度敏感，匹配方案的弹性(-1.98)显著高于返利方案(-0.87)，这与理论预测相反但符合实验发现。
AI.research_question: 慈善捐赠在返利和匹配方案下的价格弹性有何差异？两种方案是否如理论预测那样具有等价性？
AI.motivation: 现有文献对慈善捐赠价格弹性的研究结果存在异质性，且返利和匹配方案在理论上应具有等价性，但实验发现两者效果不同，需要系统性的元分析来整合现有证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 价格弹性理论、慈善捐赠经济学、行为经济学中的框架效应、返利与匹配方案的理论等价性假设
AI.method: 定量元分析方法，收集33项实验研究的151个弹性估计值，使用随机效应模型和多层次模型进行综合分析
AI.findings: 1) 慈善捐赠对价格高度敏感，总捐赠的元分析平均弹性为-1.25；2) 匹配方案的弹性(-1.98)显著高于返利方案(-0.87)，与理论预测相反；3) 返利-匹配差异在实验室和实地环境中都存在，但在实地环境中有所减弱
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了返利和匹配方案等价性的理论预测，为慈善捐赠的价格敏感性和框架效应提供了实证证据，解释了理论与实验发现之间的不一致
AI.practical_contributions: 为慈善机构设计捐赠激励方案提供指导，表明匹配方案在刺激捐赠方面可能比返利方案更有效，特别是在实验室环境中

title: The Threat of Sexual Corruption to Female Entrepreneurs: Evidence from a Pilot Study in Burkina Faso
affiliations: University of East Anglia, Dublin City University Business School, University College Dublin (UCD) - School of Politics and International Relations and Université Norbert Zongo

detail.title: The Threat of Sexual Corruption to Female Entrepreneurs: Evidence from a Pilot Study in Burkina Faso
detail.abstract: Sexual corruption-the abuse of public power for sexual gain-disproportionately affects women and stands as a barrier to economic participation. Drawing on a pilot survey of female entrepreneurs in Burkina Faso, we document its prevalence, modalities, and risk factors. Fourteen percent of respondents report experiencing sexual corruption, typically involving repeated or escalating demands. Incidents most often occur during efforts to obtain permits or official documents. Women in the start-up phase of a business face significantly higher risk, even after accounting for poverty, displacement, and age. The data suggests that "acts" of sexual corruption are better thought of as sets of abuses that occur over a protracted period. These findings highlight sexual corruption as a salient threat to women's entrepreneurship and underscore the need for targeted interventions and further empirical investigation.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过布基纳法索女性创业者的调查，发现14%受访者经历过性腐败（滥用公权力获取性利益），这主要发生在获取许可证或官方文件过程中，且初创期女性面临更高风险。性腐败应被视为持续发生的系列滥用行为，对女性创业构成显著威胁。
AI.research_question: 性腐败在布基纳法索女性创业者中的普遍性、表现形式和风险因素是什么？
AI.motivation: 性腐败（滥用公权力获取性利益）对女性影响尤为严重，阻碍了经济参与，但缺乏实证研究。需要了解其普遍性和特征，以制定针对性干预措施。
AI.theoretical_framework: 性腐败理论、性别与腐败研究、创业障碍理论、权力滥用框架
AI.method: 对布基纳法索女性创业者进行试点调查，收集性腐败的普遍性、形式和风险因素数据
AI.findings: 1. 14%受访者报告经历过性腐败；2. 通常涉及重复或升级的要求；3. 主要发生在获取许可证或官方文件过程中；4. 初创期女性面临显著更高风险（即使控制贫困、流离失所和年龄因素）；5. 性腐败应被视为持续发生的系列滥用行为而非孤立事件
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将性腐败概念化为持续发生的系列滥用行为而非孤立事件；2. 识别女性创业特定阶段（初创期）的脆弱性；3. 丰富性别与腐败研究的实证基础

title: Track AI White Paper: An AI-Enabled Framework for Screening the Antitrust Risks of AI Partnerships
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, Sciences Po Paris, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and Institut d'Etudes Politiques de Paris (Sciences Po)

detail.title: Track AI White Paper: An AI-Enabled Framework for Screening the Antitrust Risks of AI Partnerships

declarations.funderStatement: Project Liberty Institute

detail.abstract:
The rapid rise of generative AI after ChatGPT’s 2022 launch was initially heralded as an inflection point in the digital competition landscape. Nonetheless, it soon became clear that most major AI developers are financially tied to Big Tech through complex AI partnerships—arrangements involving exclusivity, circular spending, and extensive IP access without governance rights. The Track AI (Transparency, Regulation, Antitrust, Contracts, and Knowledge for understanding governance gaps in AI) project, launched in 2024, examines these partnerships and evaluates whether existing EU antitrust tools can address them. 

Our innovative methodology employs AI-driven analysis to provide a clearer understanding of the competitive landscape in the emerging AI industry. Our deliverables are twofold: 

1. A search tool (to be made available at a later date) that enables users to search the case law of the European Commission based on descriptions of inter-firm collaborations in natural language (e.g. ‘a supplier of a key input can nominate a director on the board of one of its customers’); 

2. Leveraging the search tool, we identified the main competitive risks that can arise in the context of AI partnerships. The tool features a detailed rubric assessing control, influence, and systemic risks. 

Our conclusion is that while AI partnerships do not represent mergers, they feature many of the competitive concerns that are usually associated with potentially anti-competitive mergers and acquisitions, such as raising barriers to entry or switching costs. Future work may extend our compliance tool to other jurisdictions (notably the US), explore cartel-like concerns, and examine regulatory interventions beyond antitrust to address the broader systemic risks created by AI partnerships.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了AI开发者与大型科技公司之间的AI合作伙伴关系，发现这些合作关系虽非并购，但具有类似反竞争并购的竞争风险。研究开发了AI驱动的搜索工具来识别这些风险，并评估现有欧盟反垄断工具的有效性。
AI.research_question: AI开发者与大型科技公司之间的AI合作伙伴关系是否构成竞争风险？现有欧盟反垄断工具能否有效应对这些风险？
AI.motivation: ChatGPT推出后生成式AI快速发展，但大多数主要AI开发者通过复杂的AI合作伙伴关系与大型科技公司绑定，这些关系涉及排他性、循环支出和广泛的知识产权访问，可能影响市场竞争。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于反垄断理论、竞争政策理论，特别是关于并购控制、市场进入壁垒、转换成本的理论框架，以及AI治理和数字竞争的相关理论。
AI.method: 采用AI驱动分析方法，开发自然语言搜索工具分析欧盟委员会案例法，建立详细评估框架分析控制、影响和系统性风险。
AI.findings: AI合作伙伴关系虽非传统并购，但具有类似反竞争并购的竞争担忧，如提高市场进入壁垒和转换成本。现有欧盟反垄断工具可能不足以全面应对这些风险。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了反垄断理论在AI合作伙伴关系中的应用，提出了评估AI领域新型竞争风险的理论框架，为数字竞争政策提供新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了实用的AI驱动搜索工具帮助识别竞争风险，为监管机构提供评估框架，为企业提供合规指导，并为未来扩展到其他司法管辖区奠定基础。

title: Learning Firm Characteristics for Asset Management

detail.title: Learning Firm Characteristics for Asset Management
detail.abstract: We propose a novel approach for constructing portfolios with learned representations of firm characteristics. Our framework introduces a multi-task self-supervised learning framework to train a tabular transformer with historical data (e.g., changes in earnings and momentum for a stock) to capture cross-sectional and temporal patterns in firm fundamentals. The model summarizes the data into lower-dimensional embeddings which we use to build similarity-based investment strategies. The Sharpe ratio, cumulative returns, and the accuracy of predicted returns of our strategy outperform standard benchmarks. Finally, we examine the key firm characteristics that the transformer identifies as most influential over time and during recessions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种使用自监督学习训练表格Transformer来学习公司特征表示的新方法，基于这些表示构建相似性投资策略，在夏普比率、累计收益和预测准确性方面优于基准。
AI.research_question: 如何利用自监督学习从公司历史特征数据中学习有效的表示，并基于这些表示构建优于传统基准的投资组合策略？
AI.motivation: 传统投资策略往往依赖于手工设计的特征和简单的统计模型，难以捕捉公司基本面中的复杂横截面和时间序列模式。需要更先进的方法来从历史数据中自动学习有意义的表示，以提升投资组合构建的效果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 自监督学习理论、Transformer架构在表格数据中的应用、表示学习理论、投资组合构建理论
AI.method: 多任务自监督学习框架训练表格Transformer，使用历史公司特征数据（如收益变化、动量等），学习捕捉横截面和时间序列模式，生成低维嵌入表示，基于这些表示构建相似性投资策略。
AI.findings: 提出的策略在夏普比率、累计收益和预测准确性方面优于标准基准。同时分析了Transformer在不同时期（包括衰退期）识别出的最具影响力的公司特征。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 将自监督学习和Transformer架构应用于公司特征表示学习；2) 提出了多任务学习框架来捕捉横截面和时间序列模式；3) 建立了基于学习表示的投资组合构建新范式。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 提供了一种优于传统基准的投资策略构建方法；2) 识别了在不同市场环境下最具影响力的公司特征；3) 为投资者提供了基于机器学习的新工具。

title: Representation theorem of temporal copula families and their corresponding Markov processes

detail.title: Representation theorem of temporal copula families and their corresponding Markov processes
detail.abstract: Temporal dependence structure of Markov processes is a major concern in academics, and the copula method can be applied for modeling Markov processes. Due to the relationship between consistent temporal copula families and Markov processes, this paper provides a unified framework for studying temporal dependence of Markov processes by the copula method. A representation theorem for homogeneous consistent temporal copula families is presented and the probability structure of the generated Markov processes is investigated. Following the representation theorem on the consistent temporal copula families, we introduce a methodology for constructing Markov martingales by adding the marginal information, and fake α-stable Lévy motions are constructed with fake Brownian motions as their special cases. The long-term dependence in the generated Markov processes is discussed and we obtain sufficient conditions for discrete time Markov processes to be β-mixing and geometric β-mixing, and the results are extended to continuous time Markov processes. Finally, numerical analysis is carried out to confirm that embedding the copula framework within Markov processes offers a practical and effective approach to financial derivative pricing and economic time-series analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个统一框架，使用copula方法研究马尔可夫过程的时序依赖性，建立了齐次一致时序copula族的表示定理，并构建了马尔可夫鞅和伪α稳定Lévy运动，讨论了生成马尔可夫过程的长期依赖性，并给出了β混合和几何β混合的充分条件，最后通过数值分析验证了该方法在金融衍生品定价和经济时间序列分析中的有效性。
AI.research_question: 如何通过copula方法统一研究马尔可夫过程的时序依赖性结构？
AI.motivation: 马尔可夫过程的时序依赖性结构是学术研究的重要关注点，而copula方法可以用于建模马尔可夫过程。由于一致时序copula族与马尔可夫过程之间的关系，需要建立一个统一框架来系统研究马尔可夫过程的时序依赖性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于copula理论、马尔可夫过程理论、一致时序copula族理论、鞅理论、Lévy过程理论以及混合性理论。
AI.method: 理论推导与证明：提出齐次一致时序copula族的表示定理；构造方法：通过添加边际信息构建马尔可夫鞅；数值分析：验证框架在金融和经济应用中的有效性。
AI.findings: 1. 建立了齐次一致时序copula族的表示定理；2. 构建了伪α稳定Lévy运动（伪布朗运动为其特例）；3. 获得了离散时间马尔可夫过程β混合和几何β混合的充分条件，并推广到连续时间情形；4. 数值分析证实了该框架在金融衍生品定价和经济时间序列分析中的实用性和有效性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了研究马尔可夫过程时序依赖性的统一copula框架；2. 建立了齐次一致时序copula族的表示定理；3. 发展了构建马尔可夫鞅和伪Lévy运动的方法论；4. 扩展了马尔可夫过程混合性的理论结果。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为金融衍生品定价提供了新的建模工具；2. 为经济时间序列分析提供了有效的分析方法；3. 通过数值分析验证了框架的实际应用价值；4. 为风险管理、资产定价等金融实践提供了理论支持。

detail.abstract: South Africa faces an unprecedented ‘electricity capacity cliff’ as 9.5 GW of baseload capacity—13.6% of peak demand—retires within a compressed 24-month window by March 2030. This study introduces the Cliff Intensity Index (CII), a dimensionless metric that quantifies the velocity mismatch between baseload retirement and renewable-integration rates. South Africa’s CII of 2.16 indicates retirement velocity exceeds integration capacity by 116% after accounting for institutional friction—eight times higher than Germany’s Energiewende during its steepest phase-out period (CII = 0.27). This positions South Africa’s transition within Vinichenko et al. (2021)’s Zone B/C, where historical precedents are rare or absent: a 33% coal decline per decade under 18% cumulative demand growth, compared to the OECD’s 11% decline under stagnant demand. Sensitivity analysis reveals the velocity mismatch is fundamentally structural—even under perfect governance, CII remains at 1.80. No single intervention achieves balanced transition velocity (CII < 1.0) before 2030. Without the timely addition of 6 GW gas capacity and sustained fleet availability above 60%, unserved energy could exceed 4 TWh annually. The analysis reveals a structural trilemma: South Africa must navigate among accepting multi-year adequacy deficits, extending coal operations beyond environmental compliance deadlines at the cost of access to climate finance, or pursuing gas bridging at scales exceeding current infrastructure and supply security. The CII framework provides a velocity-calibrated diagnostic applicable to other coal-dependent emerging economies navigating accelerated phase-outs where climate ambition confronts infrastructure reality.

AI.tldr: 南非面临前所未有的"电力容量悬崖"：到2030年3月，9.5GW基荷容量将在24个月内退役，占峰值需求的13.6%。研究引入"悬崖强度指数"(CII)来衡量基荷退役与可再生能源整合速度的错配。南非CII为2.16，表明退役速度超过整合能力116%，比德国能源转型最陡峭时期的CII(0.27)高8倍。敏感性分析显示这种速度错配是结构性的，单一干预无法在2030年前实现平衡过渡(CII<1.0)。
AI.research_question: 南非如何应对即将到来的电力容量悬崖？基荷退役速度与可再生能源整合速度之间的错配程度如何量化？这种速度错配的结构性本质是什么？
AI.motivation: 南非面临前所未有的电力容量危机：9.5GW基荷容量将在24个月内退役，占峰值需求的13.6%。这种"容量悬崖"对电力供应安全构成严重威胁，需要量化分析退役与整合速度的错配程度，为政策制定提供依据。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 悬崖强度指数(CII)：量化基荷退役与可再生能源整合速度错配的无量纲指标
2. Vinichenko et al. (2021)的转型区域框架：将南非定位在Zone B/C区域，历史先例罕见
3. 结构三难困境理论：南非必须在供电充足性赤字、延长煤炭运营、大规模天然气过渡之间做出权衡
AI.method:
1. 开发CII指标量化速度错配
2. 国际比较分析：将南非CII(2.16)与德国能源转型最陡峭时期CII(0.27)对比
3. 敏感性分析：评估不同政策干预下的CII变化
4. 情景模拟：分析不同容量增加方案对未供电量的影响
AI.findings:
1. 南非CII为2.16，退役速度超过整合能力116%
2. 速度错配是结构性的：即使在完美治理下，CII仍为1.80
3. 单一干预无法在2030年前实现平衡过渡(CII<1.0)
4. 若不及时增加6GW天然气容量并保持60%以上可用率，年未供电量可能超过4TWh
5. 南非面临结构三难困境：供电赤字、延长煤炭运营、大规模天然气过渡
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 提出CII框架，为量化能源转型速度错配提供新工具
2. 将南非案例定位在Vinichenko转型框架的罕见区域
3. 揭示能源转型中的结构性三难困境理论
4. 为其他煤炭依赖型新兴经济体提供速度校准的诊断框架
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为南非政策制定者提供量化决策工具
2. 识别关键干预点：需要6GW天然气容量和60%以上可用率
3. 预警未供电风险：可能超过4TWh/年
4. 为其他面临类似挑战的新兴经济体提供参考框架
5. 帮助平衡气候雄心与基础设施现实

title: Is Gender Parity Costly? Evidence from Rural Local Body Elections

detail.title: Is Gender Parity Costly? Evidence from Rural Local Body Elections
detail.abstract: This paper examines the causal effect of electing a female Gram Panchayat (GP) president on public employment provision under the Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Scheme (MGNREGS). Using a five-year panel of 9,622 GPs in Tamil Nadu, I find that female-led panchayats experience a 2.8 percentage decrease in total person-days worked per year compared to male-led panchayats, which amounts to 777 fewer person-days. This decline is borne more by women workers in regions governed by a female leader. The negative effect stems from the higher economic and social costs faced by female presidents, despite being on par with their male counterparts in terms of education and prior political experience. These constraints restrict their ability to govern effectively. While quotas ensure more women hold office, they may fail to deliver better outcomes on par with their male counterparts when deeper institutional barriers persist.

AI.tldr: 该研究发现，在印度泰米尔纳德邦，女性领导的村务委员会（Gram Panchayat）比男性领导的村务委员会在MGNREGS计划下提供的公共就业机会更少，女性工人受到的影响更大。尽管女性领导者在教育水平和政治经验上与男性相当，但她们面临更高的经济和社会成本，限制了治理效果。
AI.research_question: 选举女性村务委员会主席对MGNREGS计划下公共就业提供有何因果效应？
AI.motivation: 研究女性领导者在基层治理中的实际表现，特别是配额制度是否真正带来更好的政策结果，以及女性领导者面临的制度性障碍如何影响其治理效能。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于女性领导者在政治参与中面临的经济和社会成本理论，探讨配额制度与治理效果之间的关系，分析制度性障碍对女性领导者政策执行能力的影响。
AI.method: 使用泰米尔纳德邦9,622个村务委员会的五年度面板数据，采用因果推断方法分析女性领导对MGNREGS就业提供的影响。
AI.findings: 女性领导的村务委员会每年总工作日减少2.8%（相当于777个工作日），女性工人受到的影响更大。尽管女性领导者在教育水平和政治经验上与男性相当，但她们面临更高的经济和社会成本，限制了治理效果。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了配额制度可能无法自动带来更好的政策结果，强调了制度性障碍对女性领导者治理效能的重要影响，为女性政治参与理论提供了实证依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于如何支持女性领导者克服制度性障碍的启示，建议在实施性别配额的同时需要配套的支持措施，以确保女性领导者能够有效治理。

detail.abstract: Smart technologies, including artificial intelligence, IoT sensors, digital command platforms, advanced communications systems, and data-driven analytics, are reshaping the landscape of emergency management in the United States. As climate-related hazards intensify and infrastructure systems age, the limitations of traditional emergency-response models have become increasingly evident. This white paper examines the operational, economic, and policy implications of integrating advanced technologies into national emergency-management systems. Drawing on federal frameworks, state-level deployments, and real-world case studies, it demonstrates how technology-enabled emergency management improves hazard detection, shortens response times, enhances interagency coordination, and reduces disaster-related expenditures. The analysis concludes with a national implementation framework and recommendations for strengthening resilience, cybersecurity, workforce capacity, and interoperability across jurisdictions.

AI.tldr: 这篇白皮书探讨了智能技术（AI、物联网传感器、数字指挥平台等）如何重塑美国应急管理格局，分析了技术集成的操作、经济和政策影响，并提出了国家实施框架建议。
AI.research_question: 如何将先进技术整合到国家应急管理系统中，以改善灾害检测、缩短响应时间、增强机构间协调并减少灾害相关支出？
AI.motivation: 随着气候相关灾害加剧和基础设施老化，传统应急响应模式的局限性日益明显，需要利用智能技术来改进应急管理系统。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于联邦框架、州级部署和真实案例研究，构建技术赋能应急管理的理论框架，涵盖操作、经济和政策三个维度。

detail.abstract:
Capturing geopolitical and energy-related signals from unstructured text data—such as news and institutional reports—is essential for understanding crude oil price fluctuations amid rising uncertainty. However, generative large language models (LLMs) may lack the reasoning capabilities needed to uncover the causal mechanisms linking such information to market dynamics, especially under zero-shot inference scenario.
To address this challenge, we present a CoT-Enhanced large language model framework to extract factors from news headlines for crude oil price forecasting. First, we employ LLMs guided by CoT prompting to identify causal linkages between discrete news items and crude oil price dynamics --- laying the analytical groundwork for downstream evaluation; second, building on these causal insights, we develop a multi-dimensional factor quantification mechanism, where each news item is assessed along key economic dimensions using domain-informed prompts, yielding interpretable and high-resolution numerical indicators; third, we conduct temporal aggregation to synthesize daily factor representations, enabling their seamless integration with traditional time-series predictors. We find that the news factor captures geopolitical shocks, with shifts in its mean and increased variance indicating stronger price volatility. Moreover, LLMs exhibit a human-like understanding by recognizing the persistent negative impact of geopolitical events on crude oil prices. Experimental results demonstrate that incorporating domain-specific energy economics knowledge through CoT reasoning significantly enhances zero-shot extraction of predictive factors, with consistent and substantial improvements in out-of-sample predictive performance across multiple forecast horizons --- daily, 2-day, and weekly (5-day) forecasts. Further analyses examine the information overlap between news-derived factors and traditional numerical data. Additionally, we perform perturbation experiments to explore the impact of sentiment injection in prompts and evaluate the framework's stability when exposed to anomalous domain knowledge.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于思维链增强的大型语言模型框架，从新闻标题中提取因素用于原油价格预测。通过CoT提示引导LLMs识别新闻与油价之间的因果关系，开发多维因素量化机制，并将提取的因素与传统时间序列预测器结合，显著提升了零样本预测性能。

AI.motivation: 传统生成式大型语言模型在零样本推理场景下缺乏揭示文本信息与市场动态之间因果机制的推理能力，而地缘政治和能源相关信号对理解原油价格波动至关重要。

AI.method: 1. 使用CoT提示引导LLMs识别新闻与油价之间的因果关系；2. 开发多维因素量化机制，沿关键经济维度评估新闻项目；3. 进行时间聚合生成每日因素表示；4. 将提取的因素与传统时间序列预测器集成。

AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个结合因果推理和领域知识的LLM框架，增强了文本信息到数值指标的转化能力；证明了CoT提示在零样本金融预测任务中的有效性；建立了文本因素与传统数值数据之间的信息重叠分析框架。

detail.abstract: It is taught in textbooks that economic cost is the proper measure of costs and economic profit is the proper concept for understanding firms’ maximization. This paper shows that, using correct decision rules, maximizing accounting profits leads to the maximization of economic profits, and vice versa. This paper also discusses generally profit maximization for discrete decision problems and studies the conditions under which managers are unable to maximize economic profits. This paper argues that accounting measures of costs and profits are not only practical in reporting tax and firms’ earnings, but also realistic in helping managerial decisions for profit maximization.

detail.abstract:
Healthcare financial operations remain structurally siloed, with insurance verification, payment processing, and staff compensation managed through disconnected legacy systems. These fragmented workflows create cost uncertainty for patients, administrative friction for providers, and systemic inefficiencies across the revenue cycle.

This research introduces the concept of a Financial Nervous System—an AI-driven architectural framework that unifies real-time insurance intelligence, multi-modal payment orchestration, and event-based staff attribution.
By embedding financial logic directly into the clinical workflow, the proposed system increases transparency, accelerates reimbursement, enhances staff fairness, and enables predictive financial governance.
This framework represents a shift from transactional revenue-cycle tools toward an integrated, system-level architecture designed for next-generation healthcare delivery environments.

detail.abstract: After optimizing over trillions of candidate recession indicators, this work shows broader measures of labor utilization in standard turning-point frameworks, like a U6-based Sahm-style rule, signals recessions about one month earlier than conventional indicators and roughly five months before official dating. Comprehensive utilization measures capture both rising slack and early distress among economically vulnerable groups, which tend to deteriorate first. Extending this approach by education, race, and other margins produces more responsive indicators and reveals heterogeneity in labor-market volatility and recovery. These modified indicators improve recession dating and inform policy design.

AI.method: 通过优化数万亿个候选衰退指标，在标准转折点框架中测试各种劳动力利用指标。使用U6失业率构建Sahm式规则，并与传统指标进行比较。进一步按教育程度、种族等维度扩展分析，揭示劳动力市场波动和复苏的异质性。

AI.theory_contributions: 1. 扩展了Sahm规则的理论框架，纳入更全面的劳动力市场指标。2. 提出了基于多维劳动力市场分解的衰退预警理论。3. 为理解经济衰退中不同群体受影响的时间差异提供了理论解释。

detail.abstract: Artificial Intelligence has become a strong catalyst for change in modern healthcare, and particularly in surgical data science. As operating rooms increasingly become technologically advanced, sensor-rich environments, the need has grown significantly for intelligent systems that can interpret complex surgical processes. One of the key applications in this regard is AIpowered surgical workflow recognition. This is focused on automatic understanding, classification, and prediction of the procedural steps, actions, and contextual events across an entire surgery. Surgical workflow recognition plays a vital role in enhancing patient safety, improving operational efficiency, and informing surgeons in real-time with data-driven insights. Traditional approaches have heavily relied on manual documentation, subjective human observation, and postoperative video review; these activities are all timeconsuming, error-prone, and vary greatly among different practitioners. In contrast, the recent development of AI, especially deep learning techniques like CNNs, RNNs, LSTMs, GRUs, and Transformer-based architectures, allowed for automated interpretation of surgical videos and sensor data with unprecedented accuracy and speed.

detail.title: Product Innovation in the UK Mortgage Market: The Case of Green Mortgages
detail.abstract: We study product innovation in the UK mortgage market by analysing when and how attributes outside the traditional structure of mortgage contracts become pricing relevant. To do so, we develop a stylised framework that treats mortgage products as structured bundles of attributes, focusing on the two-part tariff, comprising interest rates and fees, to infer innovation from pricing patterns. Our empirical strategy first uses transaction-level data and exploits within-product variations over time to detect when new product features affect pricing, which we apply to the case of green mortgages. Matching Energy Performance Certificates (EPCs) to UK mortgage originations, we show that EPCs become pricing-relevant in 2018, with lenders starting to offer pricing discounts for loans to buy properties with higher energy efficiency. We also use offer-level data on advertised green products to precisely estimate pricing discounts. We detect considerable green discounts, which reach up to 15 basis points in 2022. Mortgages against high EPC properties are concentrated in new buildings, suggesting relaxed credit constraints and increased housing investment, with implications for the broader economy.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了英国抵押贷款市场中产品创新，特别是绿色抵押贷款如何影响定价。研究发现，从2018年开始，能源绩效证书（EPC）评级成为抵押贷款定价相关因素，高能效房产可获得定价折扣，2022年折扣最高达15个基点。

AI.motivation: 研究抵押贷款产品创新，特别是绿色抵押贷款如何通过定价模式反映创新，以及这种创新对更广泛经济的影响。
